problem_statement: OtCliCommandRunner can spuriously raise ExpectLineTimeoutError for asynchronous commands under fast-forwarding virtual-time simulation. The simulated timeout budget can be consumed before the background reader has delivered CLI output that is already available from the transport. Commands such as scan, discover, ping, and networkdiagnostic get must recognize completion output arriving at this boundary, preserving response order and accepting both Done and Error responses. Truly missing completion must still produce a bounded timeout. Preserve synchronous commands, command echo handling, log filtering, and reader callbacks.
orientation: OTCI command-runner tests use Python and the real upstream command handler with a scripted CLI transport. Run `run_tests`; no firmware build, board, emulator, or full virtual-time simulation is needed. The implementation lives under tools/otci/otci.
